checks: actual UI calculate, independent verify, planner submit and supervisor confirm (no confirmed fixtures)
20 configuration categories: real edit/save and duplicate-copy rejection preserve confirmed plan/input/confirmation bytes
material master, tool and inventory positive add/copy/allowed delete use actual main editor
allowed current deletion of an original confirmed-plan machine creates a new revision, preserving the original machine and task
cross-category invalid save is atomic; keyboard error link switches table and focuses exact source field
browser reference, unit, impossible-date guards reject all writes; no-op saves keep persisted bytes unchanged
browser referenced deletion is rejected; stale draft cannot overwrite a concurrent saved revision
nontrivial cumulative execution updates and immutable sources/events: actual edit/delete guards and historical bytes
execution references cannot be rebased by changing machine/master data; structured source mapping visible without raw JSON
all24 populated categories: list, positive/negative applicable filters, keyboard detail/related navigation and actual CSV downloads
material allocation navigation keeps saved plan provenance; genuine confirmed snapshot retains original inputs after edits
query role read-only; explicit export grant/revoke, role spoof, member removal and audit trusted actor
supervisor actual main editor save200 preserves confirmation
remaining: Full positive add/copy/delete coverage for categories not explicitly listed
